# SYNESIS_E164 — Warning

## Description

`field_name` not supported yet (reason).

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: the field `field_name` cannot enter an Alpaca key yet
  (reason). Planned for a later version; use ITEM fields and SOURCE fields
  written in the annotation files.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **AlpacaFieldNotSupported**: `block`, `field_name`, `reason`
